extracted.intended_audience: applicants, agents, and patent attorneys filing or administering patents in South Africa (including parties dealing with Budapest Treaty deposits)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and documentary requirements for filing, prosecuting, amending, opposing, maintaining and recording patents under the South African Patents Act (forms P2–P25, schedules). Includes national-phase entry (PCT), Budapest Treaty deposit requests, agent registration, and related formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting documents required on filing an application
rubrics_metrics.description: When requesting processing/filing, the application must be accompanied by required supporting documents (e.g., certified priority documents, translations of priority documents, assignment of priority rights, copy of Form P2 and the specification, declaration and power of attorney on Form P3, request for ante-dating on Form P4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form enumerates these items explicitly; mark the relevant documents with a cross in the appropriate block and furnish any certified priority document numbers. See Forms P25, P5 and related notes for the enumerated list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address for service requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have an address for service in the Republic of South Africa.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the address for service is that of a registered agent, the name of the agent's firm and the town/city are sufficient. Furnish street address for natural persons and principal place of business for corporations where possible. Applicants are reminded of regulation references (e.g., regs 29, 34–37).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees payable as per Schedule 1
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees in respect of filings, renewals, amendments and other requests are payable in terms of Schedule 1 to the Regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific fees are indicated on each form (e.g., R5, R20, R25 listed on certain application forms). The duplicate will be returned but is not valid unless endorsed with the official stamp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duplicate lodging and official stamp rule
rubrics_metrics.description: A duplicate of the lodged form will be returned to the applicant's address for service as proof of lodging but is not valid unless endorsed with the official (office) stamp.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This note appears on multiple forms — the returned duplicate serves only as proof of filing when stamped by the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration and power of attorney content (Form P3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form P3 must contain a declaration with specified statements about the declarant's authority and facts (applicant identity, authority to make the declaration, inventors named, right to apply, belief that patent would have no lawful ground for revocation, if a convention application that the earliest claimed priority is first in a convention country, and authorisation of firm partners/staff to act as address for service).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form provides numbered clauses (1–6) that must be completed and signed (place/date/signature). The declarant states capacity (e.g., position in applicant) and includes particulars of any corporate applicant's nature and country of incorporation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required bibliographic particulars for register entries (Form P2 / register fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: Register entries require specific bibliographic items: official application no., international classification, full names of applicants/patentees, assignees, inventors, priority claimed, title, addresses, patent of addition number, dates of lodging/acceptance/grant/registration, amendments/rectifications, proceedings and related dates, licences, renewals, restorations and remarks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P2 / Register fields list numerous numbered items (e.g., 01, 21, 31–33, 43–47, 51, 54, 71–76 etc.) and spaces for recording events, dates, proceedings, appeals and outcomes. Use the provided fields for official records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional specification filing fields (Form P6)
rubrics_metrics.description: A provisional specification filing (Form P6) must state lodging date, official application number, full name(s) of applicant(s) and inventor(s), and title of invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P6 is to be lodged in duplicate and contains the minimal bibliographic data required for a provisional filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete specification filing fields (Form P7)
rubrics_metrics.description: A complete specification filing (Form P7) must state lodging date, official application number, international classification, full name(s) of applicant(s)/inventor(s), and title of invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P7 mirrors P6 but includes the international classification (item 51) appropriate for a complete specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication particulars and abstract limits (Form P8)
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication particulars must include official application no., lodging and acceptance dates, international classification, names of applicants and inventors, earliest priority claimed (country), title of invention and an abstract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The abstract must be not more than 150 words. Form P8 is lodged in duplicate and asks for number of sheets and classification/not-for-publication marking where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of documents acceptable for late lodging (Form P5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form P5 lists documents that may be lodged late (section 30(6), regulation 38), including a copy of the complete specification, formal drawing, publication particulars/abstract (P8), copy of figures for abstract, assignment of invention, certified priority documents, translations of priority documents, assignment of priority rights, copy of Form P2 and specification, declaration and power of attorney (P3), and request for ante-dating (P4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P5 must be completed and signed, providing full applicant names and address for service. The patent office will acknowledge late lodging and stamp the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application to amend provisional specification (Form P11)
rubrics_metrics.description: To amend a provisional specification the applicant must apply using Form P11, identifying the relevant pages of the specification to be amended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P11 requires lodging date, application number, applicant names, address for service, title and signature; fee indicated (R5).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amending complete specification not open to public (Form P12)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to a complete specification not open to public inspection must be applied for on Form P12 and must state the full reasons for the amendment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P12 requires lodging date, application number, agent reference, applicant names, address for service, title of invention and the full reasons for the amendment, signed and dated by agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amending complete specification open to public (Form P13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to a complete specification that is open to public inspection must be applied for on Form P13 and must include the full reasons for making the amendment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P13 carries a higher fee (R20) and requires lodging date, agent reference, application number, patentee names, address for service and the reasons for amendment; the patentee signs the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary disclosure rule (Form P14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary disclosure (Form P14) permits attaching new pages describing matter which may 'fairly be associated with' the matter described in the specification as previously framed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P14 must be dated and signed; attached pages become part of the specification subject to the fairness/association test in regulation 52(2) / section 51(8).

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition proceedings format (Form P15 and P19)
rubrics_metrics.description: Opposition forms must set out the reference number, patent/application number, full names of applicant(s)/opposer(s), nature of proceedings, grounds for opposition, documents lodged in support and address for service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P15 is used before the Registrar under sections 50(3) and 52 (regs 54–56). Form P19 (Notice of Opposition) specifies regulation references (Regulation 82) and asks for relief sought and grounds; supporting documents should be annexed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application to record transactions (Form P16)
rubrics_metrics.description: To record a transaction in a patent application or patent, use Form P16 stating the relevant section of the Act under which recording is required, nature of the transaction, supporting documents and address for service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A low prescribed fee (R7.50) is indicated; the form is dated and signed by the applicant/agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration as patent agent or patent attorney (Form P17) — declarations
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants for registration must provide full personal and business/residential addresses, dates of admission/recognitions/certificates, indicate registration sought (patent agent/attorney) and make sworn declarations: information correct; no disciplinary proceedings pending; undertaking to uphold dignity and discharge duties faithfully; undertake to be faithful, diligent and honest and not to mislead the Court, Patent Office or others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P17 carries a fee (R25) and requires signature/declared date. The form lists required background dates and certificates (admission as attorney, Patent Examination Board certificate, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for removal from register (Form P18)
rubrics_metrics.description: A registered patent agent/attorney requesting removal must declare no disciplinary enquiries or proceedings are pending and state the reasons for removal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P18 requires date of registration, registration category, full name and address and a sworn declaration; copies are to be sent to the S.A. Institute of Intellectual Property Law and Law Society as indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application for revocation (Form P20)
rubrics_metrics.description: An application for revocation must identify the applicant, the patentee, the patent number and set out the grounds for revocation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P20 is used under Section 61 (Regulation 89) before the Court of the Commissioner of Patents and must be dated and signed by applicant or agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voluntary surrender of a patent (Form P21)
rubrics_metrics.description: To voluntarily surrender a patent, the patentee must declare identity, offer to surrender, declare that no infringement action or revocation proceedings are pending, provide reasons for surrender and provide an address for service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P21 is lodged in duplicate, signed and dated by the patentee(s); fee R20 indicated on the form heading. The surrender declaration is sworn and returned with official stamp.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for notice of future proceedings (Form P22)
rubrics_metrics.description: A party may request to be notified of specified actions or proceedings relating to a patent/application (e.g., advertisement of acceptance, acceptance of complete specification, extension of time, amendment of specification).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P22 asks the applicant to state matters for which notice is desired and to provide an address for service; the Office acknowledges receipt and records name/address for service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budapest Treaty request for furnishing samples of deposited microorganisms (Form P23)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for samples under the Budapest Treaty must identify the microorganism accession number, reference the patent application/patent that refers to the deposit, indicate whether the requester wants cultivation/storage conditions, and supply certified-party details and certification boxes about publication and rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P23 must be sent to the competent industrial property office or International Depositary Authority as per procedure. The form includes certification options (publication status, right to a sample before publication, whether certified party affixed signature, etc.) and instructions on marking applicable boxes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for certificate authorising release of sample from depository (Form P24)
rubrics_metrics.description: A requesting party for release of a deposited microorganism sample must identify the deposit and page reference in the complete specification and undertake not to make the deposited culture (or derived cultures) available to third parties until the patent application is abandoned, lapses or the patent ceases, subject to limited exceptions for depositing with an international depository authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P24 requires signing the undertaking and requests the Registrar certify and forward Form P23 to the international depository authority; official date stamp and Registrar signature block provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry of international application into South African national phase (Form P25)
rubrics_metrics.description: To request national-phase processing under section 42E(1) for a PCT application designating South Africa, the applicant must file Form P25 in duplicate and include required accompanying documents (translation of international application if applicable, certified priority document(s) with numbers, translations of priority documents, copy of Form P2, declaration and power of attorney on Form P3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form P25 requires listing international filing date, priority date, international application number, applicant names/addresses, title and statement whether application/published in English; duplicate will be returned as proof of lodging and is not valid unless officially stamped.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum bibliographic and technical data elements for patent documentation (Schedule 3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent documentation must use specified numerical references and include minimum data elements: document id (10), document number (11), country code (19), domestic filing date (20), application numbers/dates (21–23), convention priority data (30–33), dates of making available/publication (40–47), technical information (50–58) including IPC (51), title (54), keywords (55), list of prior art (56), abstract/claim (57), field of search (58), references to related domestic documents (60–64), and identification of parties (70–76 such as applicant, inventor, grantee, attorney, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule 3 provides definitions and notes which indicate which items are minimum data elements for documents and for journal entries. Items marked with * indicate minimum elements for documents; the minimum data requirement may be met by indicating the date of making available to the public for the concerned document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of international country abbreviations (Schedule 4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent documentation should use standard international abbreviations of convention countries (two-letter codes) when indicating countries for priority claims and other references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule 4 lists country abbreviations (e.g., ZA for South Africa, US for United States, GB for United Kingdom, etc.) and must be used consistently on forms and documentation.
